name: Allionia
look_here_first: Look closely at one apparent windmill: three separate asymmetric flowers open together within three involucral bracts. Then inspect a mature winged anthocarp and its glands to separate Allionia incarnata from A. choisyi.

project_scope.note: First-pass source-pool learner anchors; unresolved range and comparison labels retained.

genus_diagnostics.habit: Trailing or spreading herb; the selected photo shows stems against the ground, leaves and several flowering units.
genus_diagnostics.leaves: Opposite leaves in unequal pairs; close node photo still needed.
genus_diagnostics.flower: Each apparent flower-like unit comprises three separate asymmetric flowers with three involucral bracts.
genus_diagnostics.fruit: Winged/glandular five-ribbed anthocarp, typically 2.9–4.7 mm in the existing review, variable.
genus_diagnostics.lookalike_separators: Allionia choisyi requires mature fruit convexity, rib and gland-pattern comparison. Magenta color alone is inadequate. Varieties of A. incarnata overlap in dimensions; no variety assigned from source-only name or this habit photograph.

study_strategy.warning: Provisional one-photo coverage per species. Specific missing anatomy is shown as needs-photo; no arrows verified.
